instrumentNote: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

screeners.name: PHQ-9
screeners.description: A widely used 9-question tool that screens for symptoms of depression.
questions: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed, or being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way

severity.label: Minimal
severity.message: Your answers suggest minimal depression symptoms. Keep noticing how you feel and reach out if things change.

severity.label: Mild
severity.message: Your answers suggest mild depression symptoms. Self-care and checking in with someone you trust may help.

severity.label: Moderate
severity.message: Your answers suggest moderate depression symptoms. Consider speaking with a healthcare or mental health professional.

severity.label: Moderately Severe
severity.message: Your answers suggest moderately severe depression symptoms. We encourage you to connect with a professional soon.

severity.label: Severe
severity.message: Your answers suggest severe depression symptoms. Please reach out to a mental health professional or a 24/7 helpline today.

screeners.name: GAD-7
screeners.description: A 7-question tool that screens for symptoms of anxiety.
questions: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

severity.label: Minimal
severity.message: Your answers suggest minimal anxiety symptoms. Keep up the habits that work for you.

severity.label: Mild
severity.message: Your answers suggest mild anxiety symptoms. Grounding and breathing exercises may be helpful.

severity.label: Moderate
severity.message: Your answers suggest moderate anxiety symptoms. Consider speaking with a healthcare or mental health professional.

severity.label: Severe
severity.message: Your answers suggest severe anxiety symptoms. Please reach out to a mental health professional or a 24/7 helpline today.
